answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric verification acts as a robust barrier against Sybil attacks. By requiring a unique physical timber of a user's voice to register an identity, the protocol prevents mass automation. An attacker attempting to scale fake accounts would be as light as a zephyr, lacking the tangible biological data required to bypass the filter. Because every node is verified, the network avoids a digital sonnet of fraudulent agents, forcing the adversary to incur massive operational costs.
